method: Independent binary GLB traversal of all six shipped files, not accessor bounds alone; static scene transforms; original geometry inspected but not reused.
vocabulary: Shipped player: coherent swept silver/ivory airframe, slate hard-surface separation, cyan belongs to player.
Turret/radar: warm armor, dark slate supports, eye/barrel/dish silhouettes are active targets and intentionally not borrowed.
Silo/fuel/sentinel: strong broad material zones and fitted structural joins, not dense random greeble.
Bunker: existing mapped cold hull and unmapped darkMetal only, warm line stays passive; no red target telegraph, no cyan weapon light, no texture added.
